description: AGENT side. Given a Gloam 402 price (x402 requirements, or an MPP WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge with method gloam), describe the private payment the agent would make: a self-custodial private send of the required amount to the payee, sealed to the payee's receive tag, broadcast by this server (no operator or facilitator holds its key). Plans only; to pay, call gloam_execute_private_pay, or gloam_fetch_paid to do the whole request.

note.description: Handle of the note to pay from (gloam_list_notes), if you want a specific one.

requirements.description: Encoded requirements from gloam_payment_requirements (or the raw JSON), or an MPP challenge (the WWW-Authenticate value).

name: gloam_pay_x402
title: Plan a private payment for a 402 challenge
